Request for the Planning Commission’s recommendation on a final plat for a proposed re-subdivision of  4-lot existing  lots 77, 78, 79, and 80 located at 101, 103, and 201 Mashie Drive as well as 701 Maple Drive into 6 new lots in the RS-16 zone and two waivers of subdivision requirements.

This is a RS-16, by-right, low-density, single-family residential application. It is consistent with the land-use map in the 2015 Comprehensive Plan update and current Zoning Map. The 6-lot proposal maintains the current RS-16 (Single Family Detached Residential) zone. The proposed development meets all zoning ordinance requirements of the RS-16 (Single Family Detached Residential) district as detailed in the attached staff report. However, the applicant has requested two waivers as provided for in Section 17-12 of the Towns subdivision ordinance. The project as proposed needs a waiver from Town Council for the lot deviation of more than 3 feet to accommodate needed grading/fill to build the cul-de-sac. A waiver is also being requested for the required construction of sidewalk along Follin Lane SE.  

Departmental Recommendation: Staff recommends that the planning Commission recommends that Town Council approve the 6 lot subdivision on a cul-de-sac off Mashie Drive and approve Mashie Drive, LLC’s request for waivers of the sidewalk requirement on Follin Lane and requested lot grade deviation.
